description: Diagnose an already stopped live or postmortem debug session without changing execution state. Use this when a debugger has captured the failure and you want project-frame selection, crash classification, operand/register/variable bindings, call-chain provenance, ranked hypotheses, and a fix/rebuild/reproduce/verify plan; use debug_snapshot instead when only raw evidence is needed. The tool is read-only and returns both the bounded snapshot and the derived diagnosis, including collection limitations when optional debugger evidence is unavailable.

analysis.description: Hints used to distinguish project code from runtime, system, or third-party frames.

callerDepth.description: How many project-controlled caller frames beyond the selected frame to inspect for provenance and root cause.

projectModules.description: Optional executable or library names treated as project-controlled modules during frame selection.

projectRoots.description: Optional local source-root paths used to recognize project-controlled stack frames.

disassembleAfter.description: Number of instructions after the selected instruction to request.

disassembleBefore.description: Number of instructions before the selected instruction to request.

includeDisassembly.description: Include best-effort disassembly around the selected instruction pointer when supported.

includeExceptionInfo.description: Request structured exception information for the stopped thread when supported.

includeModules.description: Include a bounded list of loaded executable images and libraries.

maxVariablesPerScope.description: Maximum variables returned per inspected scope, bounding evidence size.

moduleCount.description: Maximum loaded modules to include when module collection is enabled.

sessionId.description: Optional DAP session ID. Omit to use the backward-compatible default session.

stackLevels.description: Maximum number of stack frames to inspect when collecting crash evidence.

threadId.description: Stopped DAP thread to inspect; omit to use the session-selected stopped thread.

name: debug_diagnose_stop
title: Diagnose Current Debug Stop
